fitting.schedule: refit once per calendar month using only strictly earlier same-season games; entire date scored before updates
fitting.residual_distribution: Normal(0, training residual RMS), frozen from same monthly training fit

selection.side_rule: HOME if conditional home>=0.75; AWAY if conditional away>=0.75; otherwise abstain

settlement: F3 tie is push; pushes excluded from accuracy denominator but reported
novelty: continuous graph/ridge margin ratings; not ordinal likelihood, Davidson, Poisson count model, QDA, tree, kernel, hidden-state, random-effects NRFI or threshold transfer
tuning: single frozen configuration; no lambda grid, threshold search, calibration rescue or post-result retuning
external: historical-seen development only; no pristine external claim; future external remains closed unless gate passes
